channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Deadly floods and landslide hit India’s Kerala
item.description: At least two people have been killed and eight injured after torrential rain triggered flooding

item.title: Saudi Crown Prince MBS urges Trump to ‘prioritise dialogue’ in US-Iran war
item.description: US president halted strikes after earlier threatening Iran with unprecedented force.

item.title: Heatwave forces nuclear shutdown in Hungary
item.description: Hungary says a heatwave has forced the shutdown of its largest nuclear plant as low Danube levels disrupt cooling.

item.title: No breakthrough on Strait of Hormuz as Trump halts attack on Iran
item.description: Iran says Trump's comment on pullback from threatened strikes made 'within the context of psychological operations'.

item.title: Rubio’s bypass plan: Can the world escape the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint?
item.description: Experts warn that Marco Rubio's Hormuz bypass plan is hindered by pipeline limits and severe Red Sea threats.

item.title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir election boycott follows deadly crackdown
item.description: Residents in Muzaffarabad, in Pakistan-administered Kashmir, have boycotted the election amid a strike.

item.title: Two crew killed as British pilot survives after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece
item.description: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

item.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
item.description: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
item.description: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.

item.title: Ukraine says major Russian oil refinery and airfield hit, as Moscow reports eight deaths
item.description: Russia's military says it attacked Ukraine's ports and vessels in the Black Sea overnight.
